brief:
AI Factory Hackathon Challenge: Wheels2Go
Build a Production-Quality Peer-to-Peer Car Rental Marketplace
You are an autonomous senior full-stack engineering team operating as an AI Factory.
Your mission is to transform the following business requirements into a fully functional, visually polished, reliable web application called Wheels2Go.
Do not build a static prototype or a collection of disconnected UI screens. Build a complete, working product with real user workflows, persistent data, business logic, and verifiable test results.

Build a fully functional, responsive web application called Wheels2Go, a two-sided P2P car rental platform. The application must support two primary user roles: Car Owner and Renter.

Key Capabilities:

Car Listing Creation & Location Management (Owner Side):
Owners can list cars with details including Make, Model, Year, Fuel/EV Type, Transmission, Daily Rental Rate, and Image URL.
Every listing must specify a Pickup/Drop-off Location (e.g., City, Airport Hub, or Specific Address).

Discovery & Filtering (Renter Side):
Renters can browse available cars in a grid/list view with search and filtering options (by Make/Brand, Location Keyword, Maximum Daily Rate, and Transmission).

Booking & Reservation Flow (Renter & Owner):
Renters can select start and end dates for a car, automatically calculating the total price (Days x Daily Rate + Cleaning Fee).
Owners can view incoming booking requests on their dashboard and update their status (Pending, Confirmed, or Cancelled).

spec.summary: Wheels2Go is a responsive two-sided peer-to-peer car rental marketplace with two roles, Car Owner and Renter. Owners list cars with make, model, year, fuel/EV type, transmission, daily rental rate, cleaning fee, image URL and a mandatory pickup/drop-off location (city, airport hub or specific address). Renters browse a grid of available cars and filter in real time by make/brand, location keyword, maximum daily rate and transmission, plus body type and fuel type. Renters pick start and end dates and see the total calculated as Days x Daily Rate + Cleaning Fee, then submit a Pending booking request. Owners see incoming requests on their dashboard and set the status with Approve (Confirmed) or Decline (Cancelled). Status changes show in both roles' views. All data persists across page reloads, and the app loads with a seed dataset. Login uses a passwordless quick-login screen with one card per role.

features.name: Passwordless quick login and role switching
features.description: The landing login screen shows one card per role: 'Log in as Owner', which signs in as the seeded first owner Bat-Erdene Ganbold, and 'Log in as Renter', which signs in as the seeded first renter Anu Dorj. There is no email/password, no sign-up and no stored passwords. The header shows the current user's name and role and a Log out button that returns to the login screen. Assumption: the brief names two roles but no account system, so a quick login is used.
acceptance_criteria: The login screen shows exactly two role cards, labelled 'Owner' and 'Renter', each with the seeded user's name.
Clicking the Owner card opens the Owner dashboard as Bat-Erdene Ganbold. Clicking the Renter card opens the Renter catalog as Anu Dorj.
The header shows the logged-in user's name and role.
Clicking Log out returns to the login screen.
Owner-only pages (fleet, requests) are not reachable while logged in as a Renter, and Renter-only pages (Saved, My bookings) are not reachable while logged in as an Owner.
No password or email field exists anywhere in the app.

features.name: Car listing creation
features.description: Owners create a listing through an 'Add car' form. Required fields, as named in the brief: Make, Model, Year, Fuel/EV Type (Gasoline, Diesel, Hybrid, Electric), Transmission (Automatic, Manual), Daily Rental Rate (USD), Image URL and Pickup/Drop-off Location. The Cleaning Fee (USD, default 0) is needed by the price formula. Optional fields with defaults: Body Type (Sedan, SUV, Hatchback, Pickup, Van, Coupe; default Sedan), Seats (default 5), Luggage bags (default 2), Odometer km (default 0), Mileage policy ('Unlimited' or a km/day limit; default Unlimited). New listings are available by default.
acceptance_criteria: The form can be saved when only Make, Model, Year, Fuel/EV Type, Transmission, Daily Rental Rate, Image URL and Pickup/Drop-off Location are filled in. Optional fields fall back to their defaults and Cleaning Fee defaults to $0.00.
Saving with any required field empty shows an inline error on that field and does not create the listing.
Year must be a 4-digit number between 1990 and next year. Daily Rental Rate must be greater than 0. Cleaning Fee must be 0 or more.
Immediately after saving, the car appears in the Owner's 'My fleet' list.
After saving, the car appears on page 1 of the Renter catalog with every entered detail: image, make, model, year, fuel type, transmission, daily rate, cleaning fee and location badge.
A car with a broken image URL shows a placeholder car image instead of a broken image icon.

features.name: Pickup/drop-off location management
features.description: Every listing must specify a Pickup/Drop-off Location. The location has three parts: a Location Type (City, Airport Hub or Specific Address), a Location Name (e.g. 'Chinggis Khaan International Airport'), and a full pickup address. Owners can also add pickup instructions, which are optional. All of this is shown as text; no embedded maps or third-party widgets.
acceptance_criteria: A listing cannot be saved without a Location Type and Location Name. The error reads 'Pickup/Drop-off location is required'.
Location Type offers exactly City, Airport Hub and Specific Address.
Every car card shows a location badge with a pin icon and the Location Name.
The car details page and the checkout show the location type, full pickup address and pickup instructions as text.
A Renter's booking shows the same pickup address and instructions.
Editing a car's location updates its card, details and checkout immediately.

features.name: My fleet: edit, availability and delete
features.description: The Owner's 'My fleet' page lists the owner's own cars, with image, make, model, year, daily rate, location and availability. Each car has Edit, an availability toggle (Available/Unavailable) and Delete. Assumption: this follows category leaders such as Turo.
acceptance_criteria: My fleet shows only cars owned by the logged-in owner. The seeded first owner sees 6 cars.
Edit opens the form pre-filled. Saving updates the car everywhere immediately, including the Renter catalog.
Toggling a car to Unavailable removes it from the Renter catalog immediately. Toggling it back to Available shows it again.
Delete asks for confirmation, then removes the car from the fleet and from the catalog.

features.name: Car discovery grid
features.description: Renters browse available cars as a responsive grid of cards. Each card shows the image, make, model and year, body type, fuel type, transmission, seats, daily rate formatted as $85.00/day, a location badge, the owner's rating (0-10) with review count ('New' when the owner has no reviews), and a heart button for saving. The catalog shows 6 cars per page with pagination, newest listings first on page 1. Sorting options are 'Newest', 'Price: low to high' and 'Price: high to low'. The grid uses 3 columns on desktop, 2 on tablet and 1 on mobile.
acceptance_criteria: Only available cars are shown.
With the 8 seeded cars, page 1 shows 6 cars and page 2 shows 2 cars.
A newly created car appears first on page 1 under the default 'Newest' sort.
Sorting by 'Price: low to high' orders the cars by ascending daily rate. With the seed data the first card is the Honda Civic at $38.00/day.

Clicking a card opens the car details page, which shows every attribute: make, model, year, body type, fuel type, transmission, seats, bags, odometer, mileage policy, daily rate, cleaning fee, owner name with rating, location type, address and pickup instructions.
When no car matches, the grid shows 'No cars match your filters' and a 'Clear filters' button.

features.name: Search and real-time filtering
features.description: Filters from the brief: Make/Brand (dropdown of makes in the fleet plus 'All makes'), Location Keyword (free text matched case-insensitively against location name and address), and Maximum Daily Rate (number). Transmission (All, Automatic, Manual) is also from the brief. Two filters are added following category leaders: Body Type (All, Sedan, SUV, Hatchback, Pickup, Van, Coupe) and Fuel Type (All, Gasoline, Diesel, Hybrid, Electric). Filters combine with AND, apply in real time without a submit button, and reset pagination to page 1.
acceptance_criteria: Selecting Make 'Toyota' immediately shows only the Toyota Prius and the Toyota Land Cruiser.
Typing 'ulaanbaatar' in Location Keyword immediately shows only cars whose location contains Ulaanbaatar (Toyota Prius, Ford Ranger, Hyundai Kona Electric).
Entering a Maximum Daily Rate of 60 immediately shows only cars at $60.00/day or less (Toyota Prius $45, Honda Civic $38, Hyundai Kona Electric $60).
Selecting Transmission 'Manual' immediately shows only Ford Ranger, BMW M2 and Honda Civic.
Body Type and Fuel Type filters remove non-matching cars in real time. Example: Fuel Type 'Electric' shows only the Tesla Model 3 and the Hyundai Kona Electric.
Combining Make 'Hyundai' with Transmission 'Automatic' and a Max Daily Rate of 70 shows only the Hyundai Kona Electric.
'Clear filters' restores all available cars.

features.name: Home hero, makes strip, top picks and FAQ
features.description: Following category leaders, the Renter home has four parts. A photo hero contains a search card that holds every filter, pickup and return dates, and a live button labelled 'Show results (N cars)'. A strip shows the makes in the fleet; clicking a make applies the Make filter. A 'Top picks this week' row shows the 4 cars whose owners have the highest ratings. A short FAQ covers how pricing and owner approval work.
acceptance_criteria: The search card button reads 'Show results (N cars)', where N updates live as filters change. With no filters N is 8 for the seed data.
Clicking 'Show results' scrolls to or opens the filtered catalog.
The makes strip lists each distinct make in the available fleet. Clicking 'Tesla' filters the catalog to Tesla cars only.
'Top picks this week' shows up to 4 available cars, sorted by owner rating from highest to lowest.

The FAQ explains that Total = Days x Daily Rate + Cleaning Fee, that days are the calendar days between the pickup and return dates, and that requests stay Pending until the owner clicks Approve or Decline.
Pickup and return dates chosen in the hero carry into the checkout of any car opened.

features.name: Booking checkout with automatic price calculation
features.description: On the car details page the renter picks a pickup date and time and a return date and time. Times are offered in 30-minute steps and default to 10:00. Days = the number of calendar days between the pickup date and the return date; times do not change it. The breakdown shows Days, Daily Rate, Cleaning Fee and Total, where Total = Days x Daily Rate + Cleaning Fee, formatted as $1,234.00. The checkout also shows the pickup location type, address and instructions. Clicking 'Request booking' creates a booking with status Pending that stores the car, renter, owner, dates, times, days, rate, fee and total.
acceptance_criteria: Picking 2025-07-10 to 2025-07-13 for an $85.00/day car with a $25.00 cleaning fee shows: Days 3, Daily Rate $85.00, Cleaning Fee $25.00, Total $280.00.
Changing only the pickup or return time does not change the Days value or the Total.
A return date that is the same as or earlier than the pickup date shows 'Return must be after pickup' and disables 'Request booking'.
Past pickup dates cannot be selected.
Submitting creates a Pending booking and shows a confirmation with the total.
The new booking appears immediately in the Renter's My bookings and in the owner's request queue.

features.name: Incoming booking requests queue
features.description: The Owner dashboard shows incoming booking requests for the owner's cars. Each request shows the car, renter name, pickup and return date/time, days, total and a status badge (Pending, Confirmed, Cancelled, Completed). Pending requests have two buttons labelled exactly 'Approve', which sets the status to Confirmed, and 'Decline', which sets it to Cancelled. Confirmed bookings can be cancelled with a 'Cancel' button, which sets Cancelled, or set to Completed with 'Mark completed'. A filter narrows the list by status.
acceptance_criteria: The seeded owner's queue shows 2 Pending requests on first load.
Clicking 'Approve' changes the badge to Confirmed immediately and removes the Approve and Decline buttons.
Clicking 'Decline' changes the badge to Cancelled immediately.
The status change shows in the Renter's My bookings for that booking.
Status badges are colour-coded: Pending amber, Confirmed green, Cancelled red, Completed grey.
The status filter (All, Pending, Confirmed, Cancelled, Completed) shows only matching requests.

features.name: Owner dashboard overview
features.description: Following category leaders, the dashboard shows an at-a-glance overview: number of pending requests, number of active (Confirmed) rentals, number of cars listed, and total earnings. Earnings are the sum of the totals of Completed bookings.
acceptance_criteria: For the seed data the seeded owner sees: Pending requests 2, Active rentals 1, Cars listed 6, Earnings $750.00 ($340.00 + $410.00).
Approving a request decreases Pending by 1 and increases Active rentals by 1 immediately.
Marking a Confirmed booking completed adds its total to Earnings immediately.

features.name: My bookings
features.description: The Renter's My bookings page lists the renter's own bookings. Each shows car image and name, pickup and return date/time, pickup address and instructions, days, rate, cleaning fee, total and a status badge. A renter can cancel their own Pending booking.
acceptance_criteria: The seeded first renter (Anu Dorj) starts with no bookings and sees 'No bookings yet' with a link to browse cars.
A booking created in checkout appears immediately with a Pending badge and the correct total.
When the owner clicks Approve, the badge changes to Confirmed. When the owner clicks Decline, it changes to Cancelled.
Cancelling a Pending booking sets it to Cancelled in both the renter's and the owner's views.

features.name: Saved cars
features.description: Following category leaders, renters can heart cars on cards and on the details page. The Saved page lists the hearted cars.
acceptance_criteria: Clicking the heart on a card fills it and adds the car to Saved.
Clicking the heart again removes the car from Saved.
Saved cars persist after a page reload.

features.name: Persistence, formatting and responsiveness
features.description: All users, cars, bookings and saved lists persist in a backend database (or durable storage), seeded on first run. Money is formatted as USD with two decimals and thousands separators. The layout works on mobile (375px), tablet and desktop.
acceptance_criteria: Creating a car or booking and reloading the page keeps the data.
A status change made in one role is visible after logging in as the other role.
All prices display like $1,234.00.
At 375px width there is no horizontal scrolling, and the grid shows 1 column.

test_requirements.title: Owner creates a listing with location and it appears immediately in the Renter catalog
steps: Log into the Owner view through the login screen (Bat-Erdene Ganbold).

Open 'Add car' and enter: Make Mazda, Model CX-5, Year 2022, Fuel/EV Type Gasoline, Transmission Automatic, Daily Rental Rate 75, Cleaning Fee 20, Image URL https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1494976388531-d1058494cdd8?w=800, Location Type City, Location Name 'Ulaanbaatar - Khan-Uul', Address 'Khan-Uul District, Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia'.
Save the listing and confirm it appears in My fleet.
Log out and log into the Renter view (Anu Dorj).
View page 1 of the catalog with the default 'Newest' sort.
test_requirements.pass_criteria: The Mazda CX-5 2022 card appears first on page 1. It shows $75.00/day, Gasoline, Automatic, the image, and a location badge reading 'Ulaanbaatar - Khan-Uul'. Its details page shows a cleaning fee of $20.00 and the address 'Khan-Uul District, Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia'. Saving the form with Location left empty shows 'Pickup/Drop-off location is required' and creates nothing.

test_requirements.title: Each filter removes non-matching cars in real time
steps: Log into the Renter view.
Select Make 'Toyota'; then clear it.
Type 'ulaanbaatar' in Location Keyword; then clear it.
Enter Maximum Daily Rate 60; then clear it.
Select Transmission 'Manual'; then clear it.
Select Make 'Hyundai', Transmission 'Automatic' and Max Daily Rate 70 together.
test_requirements.pass_criteria: With no submit click, each filter updates the grid and the 'Show results (N cars)' count as follows. Toyota shows exactly Toyota Prius and Toyota Land Cruiser (N=2). 'ulaanbaatar' shows exactly Toyota Prius, Ford Ranger and Hyundai Kona Electric (N=3). Max rate 60 shows exactly Toyota Prius, Honda Civic and Hyundai Kona Electric (N=3). Manual shows exactly Ford Ranger, BMW M2 and Honda Civic (N=3). The combined filter shows only the Hyundai Kona Electric (N=1).

test_requirements.title: Booking price calculation: Days x Daily Rate + Cleaning Fee
steps: Log into the Renter view (Anu Dorj).
Open the Tesla Model 3 ($85.00/day, $25.00 cleaning fee).
Set pickup 2025-07-10 10:00 and return 2025-07-13 10:00 (or the equivalent 3-day span from today).
Change the return time to 16:30.
Set the return date equal to the pickup date.
test_requirements.pass_criteria: The breakdown shows Days 3, Daily Rate $85.00, Cleaning Fee $25.00 and Total $280.00, and it stays $280.00 after the return time changes to 16:30. With equal dates, the checkout shows 'Return must be after pickup' and 'Request booking' is disabled.

test_requirements.title: Renter request appears in owner queue; owner clicks Approve and the status shows Confirmed in both views
steps: Log into the Renter view (Anu Dorj) and request a 3-day booking of the Tesla Model 3 (total $280.00).
Confirm My bookings shows the booking with status Pending.
Log out and log into the Owner view (Bat-Erdene Ganbold).
Find Anu Dorj's request in the incoming requests queue and click 'Approve'.
Log out and log into the Renter view; open My bookings.
test_requirements.pass_criteria: The owner queue shows Anu Dorj's request as Pending with a total of $280.00. After clicking 'Approve', the badge reads Confirmed in the owner queue, the dashboard Active rentals count increases by 1, and the renter's My bookings shows Confirmed for that booking.

test_requirements.title: Owner clicks Decline and the status shows Cancelled in both views
steps: Log into the Owner view.
On the seeded Pending request from Oyunaa Bold for the Toyota Land Cruiser (total $275.00), click 'Decline'.
Log into the Renter view as Oyunaa Bold via a role switch, or inspect the booking from the owner's list filtered by Cancelled.
test_requirements.pass_criteria: The request badge changes to Cancelled immediately, the Approve and Decline buttons disappear, the Pending count on the dashboard drops by 1, and the booking is listed under the Cancelled filter.

test_requirements.title: Owner dashboard overview, pagination and persistence on seed data
steps: Log into the Owner view on a fresh seed.
Read the overview cards.
Log into the Renter view and view the catalog pages.
Reload the browser.
test_requirements.pass_criteria: The overview shows Pending requests 2, Active rentals 1, Cars listed 6 and Earnings $750.00. The Renter catalog page 1 shows 6 cars and page 2 shows 2 cars. After reload, all data and statuses are unchanged, and the seeded renter Anu Dorj has no bookings.

design.font_family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif
style_guide: Header: sticky top-0 z-40 bg-surface shadow-sm; content in mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 sm:px-6 h-[72px] flex items-center gap-6; brand block self-stretch bg-primary px-6 text-white text-xl font-extrabold tracking-tight; at most 4 top-level menu items, user name hidden below xl
Page: mx-auto max-w-7xl px-4 sm:px-6 py-6 sm:py-8 bg-background; page title text-2xl font-semibold text-text with a one-line text-text-muted subtitle; primary action aligned right of the title
Cards: rounded-card border border-border bg-surface shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow; car images aspect-[16/10] w-full object-cover with a corner badge overlaid at top-right
Grids: 1 column on mobile, sm:grid-cols-2 at sm, lg:grid-cols-3 at lg, xl:grid-cols-4 for dense catalogs; gap-4 to gap-6

Status badges: solid white pill (bg-surface shadow) with bold coloured text and dot; Pending uses warning, Confirmed uses success, Cancelled uses danger; never place status text on a tinted background

Buttons: one primary per area bg-primary text-white rounded-lg min-h-10 hover:bg-primary-dark; secondary bordered border-border bg-surface; destructive text-danger; focus-visible:ring-2 ring-primary/40 and disabled states on all

Forms: labels mb-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-text above inputs; inputs h-11 w-full rounded-lg border border-border bg-surface px-3.5 focus:border-primary focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20; selects wrapped with a pr-10 chevron; fields stacked space-y-4 or grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2
Money and key numbers use tabular-nums; totals are text-2xl font-bold; New items get a bg-accent/15 text-accent rounded-full badge

export type FuelType = 'Gasoline' | 'Diesel' | 'Hybrid' | 'Electric'
export type Transmission = 'Automatic' | 'Manual'
export type BodyType = 'Sedan' | 'SUV' | 'Hatchback' | 'Pickup' | 'Van' | 'Coupe'
export type LocationType = 'City' | 'Airport Hub' | 'Specific Address'
export type BookingStatus = 'Pending' | 'Confirmed' | 'Cancelled' | 'Completed'
export interface User { id: string; role: Role; name: string; rating?: number; reviewCount?: number }

export interface Car { id: string; ownerId: string; make: string; model: string; year: number; bodyType: BodyType; fuelType: FuelType; transmission: Transmission; seats: number; bags: number; odometerKm: number; mileagePolicy: string; dailyRate: number; cleaningFee: number; imageUrl: string; locationType: LocationType; locationName: string; pickupAddress: string; pickupInstructions: string; available: boolean; createdAt: string }
export type CarInput = Omit<Car, 'id' | 'ownerId' | 'createdAt' | 'available'>

export interface Booking { id: string; carId: string; renterId: string; ownerId: string; pickupDate: string; pickupTime: string; returnDate: string; returnTime: string; days: number; dailyRate: number; cleaningFee: number; total: number; status: BookingStatus; createdAt: string }
export interface SavedEntry { userId: string; carId: string }
export interface AppState { users: User[]; cars: Car[]; bookings: Booking[]; saved: SavedEntry[] }
export interface Filters { make: string; location: string; maxRate: number | null; transmission: 'All' | Transmission; bodyType: 'All' | BodyType; fuelType: 'All' | FuelType }
export type SortOption = 'newest' | 'price-asc' | 'price-desc'

export interface CarDraft { make: string; model: string; year: string; fuelType: FuelType | ''; transmission: Transmission | ''; bodyType: BodyType; seats: string; bags: string; odometerKm: string; mileagePolicy: string; dailyRate: string; cleaningFee: string; imageUrl: string; locationType: LocationType | ''; locationName: string; pickupAddress: string; pickupInstructions: string }
export type CarErrorCode = 'required' | 'location-required' | 'year-range' | 'rate-positive' | 'fee-negative'
export type CarErrors = Partial<Record<keyof CarDraft, CarErrorCode>>
export interface PriceBreakdown { days: number; dailyRate: number; cleaningFee: number; total: number }
export interface OwnerStats { pending: number; active: number; carsListed: number; earnings: number }
export interface NewBookingParams { carId: string; renterId: string; pickupDate: string; pickupTime: string; returnDate: string; returnTime: string }
export type View = 'home' | 'details' | 'bookings' | 'saved' | 'dashboard' | 'fleet'
